notablePrerequisites: Myr Welder does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Myr Welder using Empowered Autogenerator's ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Myr Welder and adding {R} for each charge counter on Myr Welder.
Activate Myr Welder using Hateflayer's ability by paying {2}{R} and untapping it, dealing damage equal to Myr Welder's power to any target.
Repeat.
